chapter.heading: Psalm 8
How Majestic Is Your Name
To the choirmaster: according to The Gittith.(1) A Psalm of David.
chapter.v: You have set yourglory above the heavens .
to stillthe enemy and the avenger .
the moon and the stars ,which you have set in place ,
andthe son of man that youcare for him ?
and crowned him withglory and honor .
you have put all things under his feet ,
and also the beasts of the field ,
whatever passes along the paths of the seas .
how majestic is your name in all the earth !
